videos.script: Lesson 6 chose among Claude models. This lesson is the API they answer through. {{shape}} The Messages API asks for three things every time: a model, a limit on the answer, and the messages. Its reply says why it stopped, and a stop at the limit can leave half a JSON object. {{errors}} When the API is overloaded it answers 529, and the SDK quietly tries twice more before it tells you. {{caching}} And a cached prompt is a promise you have to check: too short, and nothing is cached, and no error says so. The usage fields are where you look.
